title: Method Flow validate-option guard
failure_signature: The validation subcommand was called with the summarizer output option instead of its receipt option after ledger updates had already succeeded.
trigger_preconditions: Several Method Flow subcommands are composed in one wrapper.
Different subcommands expose similar but nonidentical output option names.
candidate_workaround: Read subcommand help and call validate with --receipt while reserving --json-output for summarize.
recurrence_guard: Resolve each Method Flow subcommand schema independently before composing lifecycle wrappers.
rollback: Do not duplicate the already-recorded methods or witnesses; resume from ledger state and regenerate validation and summary receipts.
scope_boundary: Phase-local Method Flow CLI use only; no scientific or production claim.
